name: n6-sufler
//: из N5: projects/05-podcast-clips-opus/package.json — workspaces и скрипты; сборка без packages/shared и s3; виджет (apps/widget, фича widget-runtime-and-badge) собирается ПЕРВЫМ — его манифест читает web

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/widget && npm run build --workspace=packages/rag && npm run build --workspace=packages/db && npm run build --workspace=packages/queue && npm run build --workspace=apps/worker && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/rag && npm run build --workspace=packages/db && npm run build --workspace=packages/queue && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace=packages/rag && npm run build --workspace=packages/db && node packages/db/dist/migrate.js
